about_the_game:
Thank you all for your attention and support to our game! We are pleased to announce that the trial version of the game is now available. In this version, we invite everyone to experience the basic gameplay of the game and provide us with valuable feedback.

If you encounter any bugs or have improvement suggestions during the experience, please feel free to contact us at any time. Your feedback is crucial for us to improve the game, and we will do our best to optimize the gaming experience.

Contact us:

Game Introduction

Before each game starts, you can use in-game coins to purchase human soldiers, zombies, weapons, and freely choose your character and weapon configuration. The trial version includes two unique maps, with randomly generated turns, weather, and time for each round, adding more unpredictable challenges. Before entering the map, you can also adjust the game difficulty by the number of AI opponents.

After each round starts, you will be randomly born in a corner of the map. As the countdown ends, some human soldiers will transform into zombies and immediately enter the confrontation.

Human faction: You must cleverly use melee weapons to permanently eliminate zombies, as launch weapons can only briefly kill zombies, and after killing them, they will be resurrected. Reasonably utilize ammunition, skills, and supply boxes to resist zombie hordes and avoid infections until the end of the turn. Alternatively, you can search for a transformation supply box and transform into a powerful hero, permanently killing all zombies with unique melee weapons and skills.

Zombie faction: Your mission is to break through human defenses, infect as many humans as possible as zombies, and kill human heroes. Although the initial attributes are low, by reviving or picking up supply boxes, you can obtain random auxiliary skills to increase your health, defense, and other attributes.

After the final round of the game, you will receive game coins based on your performance in battle, which can be used to purchase characters and weapons for a completely different combat experience. Are you ready to face the challenge? Each round is filled with tactics and strategies, how will you choose to stand out in this life and death showdown?

content_descriptors.notes: The content contained in this game may not be suitable for all age groups or should not be accessed during work hours: frequent violent or bloody content, common adult content

short_description: This is a bio infectious shooting game. You will play as a human, resist the attack of infected individuals, wait for the opportunity to become a hero, and kill infected individuals to the point of no return. Or play the role of an infected person, infect humanity, and defeat all heroes.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
